subject.title: feat(logbook): automatic work journal plugin with Control UI timeline tab

question: Should Logbook ship as a bundled disabled-by-default OpenClaw plugin after the remaining code/proof blockers are fixed, or should screen journaling move to an external ClawHub/plugin path first?
rationale: The PR is a new user-facing screen-capture capability with plugin SDK/protocol/config surface and privacy-sensitive model routing, so code review can identify blockers but cannot settle the product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor bundled Logbook after blockers
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing path once the stale timeline race, inspectable proof, and security review are complete.

options.title: Split generic tab API from Logbook
options.body: Land the reusable plugin tab/protocol seam separately and defer the screen-journal product implementation.

options.title: Move Logbook to ClawHub
options.body: Close or pause the bundled implementation and ask for an external plugin package if core should not own screen journaling.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bundled Logbook after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as the landing path once the stale timeline race, inspectable proof, and security review are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the assigned feature sponsor and the strongest recent current-main owner signal for the plugin registry and Control UI surfaces involved.
